name: Echoes of Jurate
source:
In short: a stranger from another world, a doorstep meeting, and one truth‑testing secret.

[From [url=https://mortecius.itch.io/echoes-of-jurate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
簡而言之，一個來自異世界的陌生人，一次發生在家門口的相遇，還有一個能檢驗真相的秘密。
